judges.judge_name: Fault Finder - Latency & Market & Code Quality
judges.notes: Blind Judge A: questions every 0.1ms, 0.1pt, cache, async, streaming, p95, Sirion, surgical, logging, mermaid, dashboard latency

faults.fault: Streaming exists (on_stage + st.status) but no backpressure, no chunked transfer, no latency per-stage breakdown - questions every 0.1ms needs per-stage p50/p95, not aggregate
faults.fix: Emit per-stage latency headers and render micro-timeline in dashboard Harness Monitor tab
faults.improvement: +0.2pt: per-stage latency histogram (extract/risk/verify/llm_verify) with p95 per stage

faults.fault: Sirion mentioned in docs but not in evidence/benchmarks/comparison.md - comparison.md lacks market context judges expect in 5-min review
faults.fix: Add one paragraph + table to comparison.md: Sirion 60% faster (their metric) vs harness p95 delta (our metric), with task caveat
faults.improvement: +0.2pt: market context in the money-slide file judges actually open

judges.notes: Blind Judge B: questions every failure mode, secrets, EVAL_MOCK, docker-compose, retry, timeout

faults.fault: PDF corrupt fallback exists but no explicit corrupt-PDF test fixture - fallback unproven under chaos, 2pts per untested failure mode
faults.fix: Add tests/fixtures/corrupt.pdf + test_ingest_corrupt_pdf asserts fallback Page returned

faults.fault: DOCX corrupt fallback exists but _from_docx XML page-break detection uses raw xml string search without try - malformed XML can raise, not caught per-paragraph
faults.fix: Wrap xml search in try/except per paragraph
faults.improvement: +0.1pt: per-paragraph isolation, no single para kills doc

faults.fault: Empty contract correctly raises ValueError but API layer (advanced/src/main.py) not verified to translate it to fallback - strict fault per un-wrapped raise
faults.fix: Ensure main.py catches ValueError and returns fallback JSON; add e2e test_empty_contract

judges.notes: Blind Judge C: hunts any 0.1pt gain, docs, tests, word-number, Streamlit prod gaps, mypy, catch rate

faults.fault: README hot take not crisp one-liner - buried in long failure-mode paragraph, judge cannot quote it in 5s
faults.fix: Add one-sentence hot take: 'The most reliable number is the one most worth checking.'

faults.fault: Problem statement Who/why not quantified with user time-saved - no 'solo counsel saves 45min per MSA' claim tied to evidence
faults.fix: Add quantified value prop in README Overview with evidence link

faults.fault: REPRODUCTION.md cost table says $0.10-2.00 but no per-model cost breakdown - not reproducible budgeting
faults.fix: Add per-model cost table (gemini-flash $0.02 vs gpt-4o-mini $0.12 per 30 contracts)
